# ECG Axis Trainer

This MedNerds tool is an adapted integration of the [ECG Axis Trainer](https://github.com/david-shrk/ecgaxistrainer) by David Schaack, licensed under the MIT License.

Upstream revision used: `27c77d1033f9b086965f290a395b4cffd28b1857` (2024-02-05).

The adaptation uses the upstream German axis boundaries, limb-lead projections, ECG waveform and grid drawing, quiz angle exclusions, and answer flow. It does not include the upstream website, analytics, fonts, About/contact content, or external runtime resources.

The original MIT copyright and permission notice are preserved in [LICENSE](./LICENSE).
